title: Tech Startup Team
description: Five people working at a small AI startup in San Francisco, connected through work hierarchy, shared hobbies, and personal ties. Rich in professional milestones, side projects, and daily routines.

people.name: Nadia Reyes
people.profile: Former McKinsey consultant turned entrepreneur. Born in Mexico City, moved to SF in 2018. MBA from Stanford. Runs a tight ship but loves karaoke nights.

observations.text: Nadia Reyes co-founded the AI startup Caspian Labs in January 2022 with seed funding of $2.1 million.
Nadia Reyes earned her MBA from Stanford Graduate School of Business in 2017.
Nadia Reyes grew up in Mexico City and moved to San Francisco in August 2018.
Nadia Reyes and Leo Tanaka are neighbors in the same apartment building on Valencia Street.
Nadia Reyes worked as a management consultant at McKinsey for three years before starting Caspian Labs.
Nadia Reyes runs every morning along the Embarcadero, covering exactly 8 kilometers.
Nadia Reyes pitched Caspian Labs at Y Combinator Demo Day in March 2022 and secured Series A from Sequoia Capital.
Nadia Reyes speaks Spanish, English, and conversational Portuguese.
Nadia Reyes adopted a corgi named Churro from a rescue shelter in Daly City last October.
Nadia Reyes mentors two women founders through the Techstars program every quarter.
Nadia Reyes's mother is a pediatrician in Mexico City at Hospital Infantil de Mexico.
Nadia Reyes drives a black 2023 Tesla Model Y.
Nadia Reyes won the Forbes 30 Under 30 list in the enterprise technology category in 2020.
Nadia Reyes goes to karaoke at Pandora Karaoke on Post Street every other Friday with the team.
Nadia Reyes's favorite book is 'The Hard Thing About Hard Things' by Ben Horowitz.
Nadia Reyes hired Priya Sharma after meeting her at a Women in AI conference in Seattle in November 2023.
Nadia Reyes has a younger brother named Marco who works as an architect in Guadalajara.
Nadia Reyes completed the Napa Valley Marathon in April 2024 with a time of 3 hours 42 minutes.
Nadia Reyes is negotiating a partnership deal with Salesforce for Caspian Labs' AI assistant product.
Nadia Reyes cooks mole poblano from her grandmother's recipe every Sunday evening.

people.name: Leo Tanaka
people.profile: Full-stack engineer, UC Berkeley CS grad. Japanese-American, born in San Jose. Obsessed with mechanical keyboards and specialty coffee.

observations.text: Leo Tanaka co-founded Caspian Labs with Nadia Reyes and serves as the lead engineer.
Leo Tanaka graduated from UC Berkeley with a B.S. in Computer Science in 2017.
Leo Tanaka grew up in San Jose, California, where his parents run a bonsai nursery called Tanaka Gardens.
Leo Tanaka and Nadia Reyes are neighbors in the same apartment building on Valencia Street in the Mission District.
Leo Tanaka and Marcus Bell go to Equinox gym on Market Street together every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 7 AM.
Leo Tanaka built a custom mechanical keyboard with Cherry MX Brown switches and a walnut case.
Leo Tanaka previously worked at Google on the TensorFlow team for two years.
Leo Tanaka roasts his own coffee beans using a Behmor 2000AB Plus roaster.
Leo Tanaka deployed Caspian Labs' inference pipeline to AWS and reduced latency from 340ms to 87ms in February 2024.
Leo Tanaka has a black Shiba Inu named Pixel that he walks in Dolores Park every evening.
Leo Tanaka's favorite programming language is Go, which he uses for all of Caspian Labs' backend services.
Leo Tanaka contributes to an open-source vector database project called MilvusLite every weekend.
Leo Tanaka won second place at the PennApps hackathon in 2016 with a real-time speech translation app.
Leo Tanaka took a two-week trip to Kyoto in March 2024 to visit his grandparents.
Leo Tanaka drives a silver 2021 Subaru Outback.
Leo Tanaka's favorite ramen spot is Mensho Tokyo on Geary Boulevard.
Leo Tanaka plays on a recreational volleyball team at Mission Playground on Thursday evenings.
Leo Tanaka reads a research paper every morning before work and annotates it in Notion.
Leo Tanaka's older sister Yumi is a product manager at Apple in Cupertino.
Leo Tanaka and Priya Sharma pair-program every Tuesday afternoon on the recommendation engine.

people.name: Maya Johansson
people.profile: Swedish-American designer with a background in industrial design. Moved from Stockholm to SF in 2021. Passionate about ceramics and cycling.

observations.text: Maya Johansson joined Caspian Labs as UX/UI designer in June 2023.
Maya Johansson studied industrial design at Konstfack University in Stockholm, graduating in 2019.
Maya Johansson moved from Stockholm to San Francisco in September 2021.
Maya Johansson and Marcus Bell carpool to the Caspian Labs office in SoMa every weekday.
Maya Johansson cycles to the Ferry Building Farmers Market every Saturday morning on her blue Bianchi road bike.
Maya Johansson takes a ceramics class at the Clayroom Studio on Valencia Street every Wednesday evening.
Maya Johansson redesigned Caspian Labs' dashboard interface in January 2024, increasing user engagement by 35%.
Maya Johansson's favorite design tool is Figma, and she has published 12 community templates.
Maya Johansson's father is a furniture maker in Gothenburg who trained her in woodworking.
Maya Johansson adopted a tabby cat named Fika from the SF SPCA last March.
Maya Johansson speaks Swedish, English, and basic Mandarin that she learned at a night school in the Richmond District.
Maya Johansson won a Red Dot Design Award in 2020 for a modular standing desk concept.
Maya Johansson lives in a studio apartment on Folsom Street in the Mission District.
Maya Johansson is training for the San Francisco Century Ride, a 100-mile cycling event in September 2024.
Maya Johansson's favorite coffee shop for remote work is Sightglass Coffee on 7th Street.
Maya Johansson ran a design sprint workshop at Caspian Labs in April 2024 that produced 14 new feature concepts.
Maya Johansson sold three ceramic bowls at the Renegade Craft Fair in July 2024 for $85 each.
Maya Johansson and Priya Sharma attend a weekend yoga class at Yoga Tree on Hayes Street.
Maya Johansson's older brother Erik is a marine biologist at Uppsala University in Sweden.
Maya Johansson keeps a physical sketchbook and fills one Moleskine notebook every two months.

people.name: Marcus Bell
people.profile: Former journalist turned marketer. African-American, grew up in Oakland. Passionate about community building and home brewing.

observations.text: Marcus Bell joined Caspian Labs as head of marketing in March 2023.
Marcus Bell previously worked as a tech reporter at Wired magazine for four years.
Marcus Bell grew up in Oakland, California, and graduated from Howard University with a journalism degree in 2015.
Marcus Bell and Leo Tanaka go to Equinox gym on Market Street together every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 7 AM.
Marcus Bell and Maya Johansson carpool to the Caspian Labs office in SoMa every weekday.
Marcus Bell launched Caspian Labs' blog, which reached 50,000 monthly readers by August 2024.
Marcus Bell brews beer in his garage in the Temescal neighborhood using a Grainfather G40 system.
Marcus Bell's best homebrew is a West Coast IPA called 'Foghorn' that won a silver medal at the Oakland Homebrew Festival.
Marcus Bell drives a green 2022 Rivian R1T pickup truck.
Marcus Bell has a golden retriever named Walter who goes to the office with him every day.
Marcus Bell ran the Big Sur Marathon in April 2024 in 4 hours 11 minutes.
Marcus Bell's mother is a retired public school principal from Oakland Unified School District.
Marcus Bell organized Caspian Labs' first user conference at the Bespoke Events space in October 2024 with 300 attendees.
Marcus Bell mentors two high school students through the Year Up program in Oakland.
Marcus Bell's favorite podcast is 'How I Built This' by Guy Raz.
Marcus Bell is writing a nonfiction book about the Oakland tech scene, with 40,000 words drafted so far.
Marcus Bell plays pickup basketball at Lake Merritt every Sunday morning.
Marcus Bell speaks English and intermediate French, which he learned during a semester abroad in Lyon.
Marcus Bell cooked his signature smoked brisket for Caspian Labs' July 4th barbecue at Golden Gate Park.
Marcus Bell's older sister Denise is a civil rights attorney in Washington, D.C.

people.name: Priya Sharma
people.profile: MIT graduate with a specialization in NLP. Indian-American, from Boston. Avid reader and amateur baker.

observations.text: Priya Sharma joined Caspian Labs as a data scientist in December 2023.
Priya Sharma earned her M.S. in Computer Science from MIT in 2023, specializing in natural language processing.
Priya Sharma grew up in Boston, Massachusetts, where her parents run an Indian grocery store called Sharma's Spice Market in Cambridge.
Nadia Reyes hired Priya Sharma after meeting her at a Women in AI conference in Seattle in November 2023.
Priya Sharma and Leo Tanaka pair-program every Tuesday afternoon on the recommendation engine.
Priya Sharma and Maya Johansson attend a weekend yoga class at Yoga Tree on Hayes Street.
Priya Sharma published a paper on few-shot learning for dialogue systems at ACL 2023.
Priya Sharma bakes sourdough bread every weekend using a 3-year-old starter she named 'Naan'.
Priya Sharma built Caspian Labs' citation extraction model that achieved 91% F1 score on internal benchmarks.
Priya Sharma reads two books per week and tracks them on a Notion database with 247 entries so far.
Priya Sharma's favorite book is 'Godel, Escher, Bach' by Douglas Hofstadter.
Priya Sharma lives in a one-bedroom apartment in the Inner Sunset and walks to Caspian Labs via Golden Gate Park.
Priya Sharma volunteers as a teaching assistant for an intro to Python course at the SF Public Library on Saturday mornings.
Priya Sharma won the Kaggle Days championship in San Francisco in February 2024.
Priya Sharma speaks English, Hindi, and Tamil fluently.
Priya Sharma's older brother Ravi is a cardiologist at Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston.
Priya Sharma is training a personal GPT model on her own journal entries as a side project.
Priya Sharma brought her homemade chai masala cookies to the Caspian Labs holiday party and they sold out in 15 minutes.
Priya Sharma rides a red Specialized Allez road bike to commute when the weather is clear.
Priya Sharma adopted a rabbit named Bayes from the House Rabbit Society in August 2024.
